analysis.task_statement: Determine whether the spectrum-ts SDK surfaces inbound iMessage read receipts (it did not), file a Linear issue, write a consumer-facing plan, then implement inbound read receipts for the iMessage remote provider end-to-end: core support (readSchema export, wrapNestedContent read arm, webhook deserializer), a message.read mapping in the iMessage stream, docs, and tests. Follow-ups debugged a real-world run (receipts were being dropped because the upstream event's actor is the receiving line, not the reader), decided to keep debug logging, and validated/fixed a PR review finding about shared-mode line attribution.
